tasks.short: Set fundraising goals, contribution safeguards and disbursement coordination

steps.what: Establish goals for soliciting funds against organisational needs
Develop contribution collection and safeguarding policies
Coordinate disbursement requirements and resolve contribution restrictions

tasks.design: Keep goal setting and policy judgement with the manager using {CRM} and {DOCS}. Coordinate disbursements with finance through existing records in {ERP}; no automatic fund release is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Targets, safeguards and restrictions depend on organisational priorities and contribution conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing records support decisions, but no repetitive subtask is assumed large enough to justify a new build.
tasks.still_hard: Balancing fundraising ambitions, donor restrictions and financial controls.
tasks.human_edge: The manager decides defensible goals and resolves competing commitments with finance.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in managerial or financial authority.

reach.task: Translate a funded programme's resource needs into a fundraising brief
reach.learn: Programme dependencies and restricted funding conditions

evidence.claim: Fundraising goals, safeguards and restricted-fund coordination require contextual judgement; no new labour saving is assumed.

assumptions: Boundary is managerial goals, policy contribution and disbursement coordination, excluding ledger posting and payment execution.

Finance supplies existing contribution records and approved policies. Proposed policy changes from s2 only become approved policies after the existing policy-owner review, before affected disbursements in s3. Review and finance execution are unchanged outside this focal boundary; no new unpaid transfer or saving is claimed.
No structured-input automation is proposed. Use native records and reports before any custom component.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new system or recurring process is introduced.
unknowns: Who approves policy and fund release
research_questions: Which coordination delays arise from unresolved restrictions rather than record preparation?

already_counted.description: Goal setting, policy development and disbursement coordination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives gross and net0. Managerial judgement and finance's existing work are unchanged.

tasks.short: Maintain relationships that create fundraising opportunities

steps.what: Maintain working relationships and explore new fundraising opportunities

tasks.design: Keep relationship building with the manager, informed by existing history in {CRM}. The manager listens, follows through and explores opportunities with clients, officials and media representatives.
tasks.previous_blocker: Trust develops through credible personal interactions and sustained follow-through.
tasks.enabler_now: No new component is proposed for the relationship itself.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding interests and preserving trust when organisational needs change.
tasks.human_edge: The manager senses whether an opportunity fits the relationship and can make credible commitments.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in relationship ownership or authority.

reach.task: Develop a community partnership for a funded activity
reach.learn: Programme delivery constraints and partnership expectations

evidence.claim: Fundraising relationship development depends on trust and contextual conversation; no labour reduction is assumed.

assumptions: Boundary is relationship maintenance and opportunity exploration, excluding separate campaign outreach and grant-file production.
The manager uses existing relationship history and learns stakeholder interests during s1. No inferred donor score, new structured capture or unpaid stakeholder data-entry process is assumed.
Use existing native relationship records before any custom build. Resolve overlap with awareness outreach by counting each interaction once.
Zero incremental upkeep because no additional component is introduced.
research_questions: Which unmet stakeholder interests could support a credible future fundraising opportunity?

already_counted.description: Personal relationship development and opportunity exploration

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives gross and net0; relationship time is unchanged.

tasks.short: Develop and compile grant submission materials

steps.what: Check funding requirements and select verified proposal facts
Develop narrative materials for the funding application

loop.purpose: Express selected programme facts against the funder's questions
loop.input: checked application brief and exact funding questions
loop.check: Check commitments, eligibility statements, outcomes and numbers against the verified brief; do not invent evidence or promises
loop.stop: One draft and one revision; manager writes unsupported or ambiguous answers manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Funders ask different narrative questions that fixed templates do not answer well

steps.what: Compile the application materials and required attachments
Verify final funding materials and release the submission package

tasks.design: The manager checks funder requirements and programme facts in {DOCS}, then reviews a bounded narrative draft. Native package templates compile the checked answers and selected attachments, and the manager verifies the exact submission package before release to the authorised submitter.
tasks.previous_blocker: Applications repeatedly combine verified programme facts, bespoke questions and attachment requirements.
tasks.enabler_now: Constrained drafting and deterministic package assembly can reduce composition and copying.
tasks.still_hard: Demonstrating eligibility, choosing a persuasive but accurate case and avoiding unapproved commitments.
tasks.human_edge: The manager judges fit, resolves missing evidence and decides which promises the organisation can make.
tasks.altitude: Less package assembly and prose composition; funding judgement and commitment authority remain unchanged.

reach.task: Prepare a traceable funding evidence checklist for a research programme

evidence.claim: Constrained proposal drafting and deterministic attachment assembly are plausible; the digest contains no measured fundraising case supporting these savings.

assumptions: Boundary is developing and compiling submission materials, excluding programme design, budget approval and actual portal submission. The existing authorised submitter's work is unchanged, with no new transfer.

Programme owners and finance produce existing programme evidence and approved budgets before s1. The manager checks and captures funder, deadline, question identifiers, word limits, chosen facts, source references, budget version and exact attachment paths and versions in s1; all selection and capture stay counted. Missing evidence requires manual clarification, not invented content.

The manager checks narrative question identifiers and text in s2. Native assembly in s3 consumes those checked fields and the s1 attachment manifest; absent or incompatible fields require manual assembly counted against savings.
Try native application and document templates before custom code; existing automatic assembly runtime earns no labour saving.
research_questions: Does drafting and package assembly reduce total preparation time after factual review and funder-specific corrections?

already_counted.description: Requirement capture and final package verification

incremental.description: Maintain application mappings and review sample packages
Additional source export and template support

approvals.approved_version: Exact application package, narrative answers, budget and attachment versions, funder and authorised submitter; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R73 gives gross27 and net19 after8 focal upkeep;2 other-role support hours remain visible. Range3-12% assumes repeated formats and approved source material, allowing funder-specific revisions and manual attachment repair.

tasks.short: Contact representatives and leaders about organisational needs

steps.what: Contact representatives and leaders to explain organisational causes and needs

tasks.design: Keep awareness contacts personal, informed by approved information and relationship history in {CRM}. The manager chooses whom to approach, explains the cause and responds to interests and concerns.
tasks.previous_blocker: Awareness depends on relevance and credibility with the particular recipient.
tasks.enabler_now: No new automated contact process is proposed.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining needs without overpromising and recognising whether a follow-up is welcome.
tasks.human_edge: The manager adapts the explanation and can respond credibly to questions.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in contact authority or relationship responsibility.

reach.task: Explain a community activity's funding needs to local partners

evidence.claim: Personal awareness contacts depend on relationship context and responsive explanation; no labour saving is assumed.

assumptions: Boundary is awareness contact, excluding campaign production and separate long-term relationship development. An interaction serving both tasks is counted once in a roll-up.

The manager uses existing approved cause facts and contact records and confirms uncertain details during the interaction. No new structured recipient score, automated outreach or unpaid data preparation is assumed.
Use existing native contact records and communication tools before a custom build.
Zero incremental upkeep because the proposal adds no component or recurring process.
research_questions: Which explanations and programme facts do representatives ask for before considering support?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives gross and net0; personal awareness contact is unchanged.
